name: 郭五鳳
objective:
Marketing Management and Research
This course examines the principles and practices of marketing management and applied market research for graduate students. It focuses on how organizations identify market opportunities, understand customer behavior, design marketing strategies, and use research evidence to support managerial decisions. Students will explore strategic marketing decision-making, consumer insights, market analytics, digital transformation, and evidence-based marketing practices. The course emphasizes both academic rigor and managerial application, preparing students to design, evaluate, and implement data-driven marketing strategies in complex global environments.
